title: Berlin Mugs - Quick Summary
kicker: WALK OF BERLIN • LIVING IN BERLIN
items: **A good Berlin mug shows a real place**, is a normal coffee size (about 300 to 350 ml) and survives a suitcase.
**Christmas market mugs** cost a few euros of deposit and only exist from late November.
**Ampelmann** is the safe classic for kids, **Starbucks** only for city-mug collectors, **KPM** porcelain for parents and weddings.
**Skip the BERLIN-in-capitals mug.** It looks the same in every city.
**My six place mugs** (Kotti, Mauerpark, Brandenburger Tor, Tiergarten, Wannsee, Gärten der Welt) are 325 ml ceramic and made to order, with free shipping to Germany, the UK and the US.
